minutes.headline: Board reviewed the draft town meeting warrant and held the FY16 budget and village district zoning for later meetings.
minutes.summary: The Select Board approved two fundraiser and roadblock requests and received a Purple Heart Community certificate. It delayed the regional 911 vote because the district agreement does not yet exist. Most of the evening went to the draft annual town meeting warrant, where several articles were recommended and the budget, village district and police bylaws were held for later.

what_happened.line: The Select Board recommended approval of warrant articles one through six as in the draft, during a long review of the draft annual town meeting warrant.
The Board continued the regional 911 district vote because the district agreement has not yet been drafted.
The Board approved a Boys and Girls Club toll booth fundraiser and a Lions Club spring roadblock.
The town manager is to cover the highway maintenance gap from free cash rather than cut the line.
A snow and ice deficit was projected, with possible state reimbursement and a proposal to cover it from free cash.

why_it_matters: Free cash is town money that is not committed to anything, so using it for highway maintenance and the snow and ice overage affects what remains for other needs and for next year's tax rate.
The FY16 budget, village district zoning and police bylaws were held, so residents will be asked to vote on them at town meeting after later Board meetings settle their wording.
watch_next: Later Board meetings on the held FY16 budget, village district zoning and police bylaw articles.
The regional 911 district vote, which waits on a drafted district agreement.
